conclusions.original_primary: Failed: protecting the initial cheap root ranking increased>=100cp losses from8 to17 on95 CP roots. No promotion.
conclusions.cpu_search: Exploratory reduction8->6, and separate confirmation7->6; paired intervals include zero. Conditional clipping did not improve.
conclusions.tactical: CPU search reduced avoidable teacher-reported mate choices4->3 on16 defense roots;14/16 two-/three-move winning-mate roots solved before any large-model call.
conclusions.low_neural: 16-position CPU version averaged8.15625 large-model positions over32 tactical roots;4 defense errors versus3 at32-position budget.
conclusions.arena: 56 games across7 configs and4 opening pairs, no truncation; no demonstrated overall strength gain.

primary.primary: combined versus baseline on >=100cp losses and separate mate events
secondary: combined vs original PUCT-512 and PUCT-31
primary.parameters: No fitting/tuning on new roots. Clip0.15 in WDL units is a heuristic trust region, not a confidence bound.
primary.exactness: Only exhaustive defending replies inside mate prover can produce solved flags. CPU fixed-depth value scores remain heuristic. Exhaustion is unknown.
primary.cpu: Independent per-decision hard caps; fair per-root-child quotas, with iterative depths. No online Stockfish used by any evaluated player.
primary.teacher: 100k proposal + 500k coherent union MultiPV; finite-node comparison, not Elo or optimality
primary.reference: Official Stockfish sf_18 search.cpp and movepick.cpp: static/search score separation, in-check evasions, ordering. Independent implementation, no source code copied.
primary.root_guard: Bound final/root traversal value within0.15 of immutable cheap child evaluation. Exact outcomes override. Added on old failure replays, before inspecting new96-root outcomes.
primary.development: Initial pre-run aborted after old-case regression showed clipping local operators was insufficient. No partial outcomes used or mixed with the full final rerun.
primary.arena: First4 new openings both colors; baseline,combined32,combined16,PUCT31,PUCT512; finite paired pilot.

confirmation.primary: cpu versus baseline confirmation of exploratory first-stage improvement
confirmation.change: Drop harmful root-value protection. Optional local clipping only when the independent CPU search completed a depth; this is heuristic evidence, not a confidence bound.
confirmation.note: Follow-up fixed before outcomes, separate from the initial96 roots. Do not hide the negative original primary combined result.

tactical.selection: One root per new game; teacher-only fixed mate<=3 or played move mated<=3 with a best move without a reported mate. No tested-player outputs used.
tactical.note: Stratified tactical challenge, not representative frequency or Elo. Finite-node labels; final common-union regrading may differ.

primary.note: Finite-budget common candidate-union labels, not optimality or Elo. Mate events mean the teacher reports a mate versus an alternative without that report, not that a draw was available. One root per new source game; bootstrap paired roots. Primary combined vs baseline fixed in plan.

limits: Frozen student and one frozen large model; no model-size or training claim.

Game groups for new roots are disjoint from prior runs; old frozen large-model whole-source overlap remains unknown.
Finite-node candidate-union grading, not exact chess truth, Elo, or representative mate frequency.
Dedicated tactical set selected by teacher only; report it separately from random root cohorts.
No blending of incomplete development pre-run results with final rerun.
No inference-budget advantage over low-budget PUCT established on ordinary roots.
